scenarios.scenario: Token guessing / brute force against POST /auth/set-password
scenarios.rationale: 256-bit random token, only sha256 stored, single-use, 72 h, IP-limited route (AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX + RATE_LIMIT_MAX ceiling), one generic 400 for unknown/expired/used/archived (smoke compares the four bodies byte for byte).

scenarios.scenario: Manager takes over a teammate's account by receiving the invite link
scenarios.rationale: shouldExposeInviteLink returns false for every non-admin actor in every mode (unit truth table); smoke asserts no link and no 'set-password' text in manager create/resend responses on success and on forced mail failure; e2e asserts no invite-link element for a manager.

scenarios.scenario: Manager escalates by creating an admin/manager, sending a password, or naming another manager
scenarios.rationale: POST /users rejects each with 403 for managers and forces managerId to the actor (smoke item 5).

scenarios.scenario: Status bypass: reactivate a never-activated account via PATCH or set a password via admin reset
scenarios.rationale: PATCH active/paused on an unusable hash -> 409 ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVATED (detection by hash prefix, not status, so archive-then-PATCH also fails); reset-password on invited/unusable -> 409; the zod enum cannot set 'invited'. Smoke checks all three.
row lock serializes; cooldown from the newest invite row (429); smoke: immediate resend 429, two parallel resends -> one 200 + one 429 and exactly one open token.

scenarios.scenario: Partial create (user without profile or token)
scenarios.rationale: insertAccount runs every write on one transaction; smoke forces a profile FK failure and finds no users row and no orphan token.
conditional UPDATE ... WHERE used_at IS NULL; smoke Promise.all of two accepts -> one 204 + one 400, never 500.

scenarios.scenario: Accept after the account was archived/paused
scenarios.rationale: UPDATE users ... WHERE status='invited' must hit one row, else the tx rolls back with the generic 400 and the token stays unconsumed (smoke checks used_at is null and status stays archived).

scenarios.scenario: Log leakage of token, link, body or MAIL_PASSWORD
scenarios.rationale: log mailer prints subject + masked recipient; deliverInvite warns with the error code only; Fastify does not log bodies; the token travels in a POST body and a URL fragment; logging grep gate shows no new matches; spy-logger unit tests.

scenarios.scenario: Tests or e2e send real mail because backend/.env says smtp
scenarios.rationale: createMailer throws for smtp under NODE_ENV=test; smoke injects the array mailer and refuses to start otherwise; Playwright backend env forces MAIL_MAILER=log (dotenv does not override set variables); ports checked free before e2e so no foreign backend is reused.
appBaseUrl takes only the env (APP_URL, else first CORS origin, else localhost); no request header is consulted; production requires an http(s) APP_URL.

scenarios.scenario: Account enumeration through invited logins or manager resend
scenarios.rationale: invited login fails with the same 'Invalid email or password' 401; manager resend on unknown/foreign ids is 403 (no 404 oracle). Accepted residual: 409 on duplicate email at create (register already exposes it).

scenarios.scenario: Production boots with a silent log mailer or plaintext SMTP
scenarios.rationale: env superRefine (separate from the CORS block) fails startup naming the key; env-mail.test.ts covers each key and the CORS-early-return case. Not proven by a booted production server (documented gap).

scenarios.scenario: Deadlock between POST /auth/set-password and resend / PATCH pause-archive-email / DELETE on the same invited user (opposite lock order)
scenarios.rationale: EVL fix cycle 1: set-password now reads the token user_id without a lock, locks the user row FOR UPDATE (lockUserForInvite), then conditionally consumes the token (user_id = locked user, unused, unexpired), then activates WHERE status=invited; same user-then-token order as every other writer. Any miss is the generic 400 and rolls back. Smoke invites 3b: 3 rounds each of set-password||resend and set-password||PATCH archived, no 500, consistent end state.
